one_liner_zh: 霍尼韋爾最新季度每股盈餘與營收均優於預期，展現穩健的業務成長動能。
one_liner_en: Honeywell reported quarterly EPS and revenue above estimates, demonstrating solid business growth momentum.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 1.95 美元優於預估的 1.82 美元，營收達 9.72 億美元。
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘 1.95 美元，優於市場預期的 1.82 美元
營收達 9.72 億美元，較去年同期成長 4.26%
獲利優於預期主要受惠於成本管控與核心業務需求穩健
highlights_en: EPS of $1.95 outperformed the consensus estimate of $1.82
Revenue reached $9.72B, representing a 4.26% year-over-year increase
Profitability beat was driven by disciplined cost control and stable core demand
risks_zh: 總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響未來工業需求
供應鏈中斷與成本通膨仍具潛在壓力
risks_en: Macroeconomic uncertainties could impact future industrial demand
Supply chain disruptions and cost inflation remain potential pressures
ai_view_zh: 觀點：本季財報優於預期釋出正面訊號，考量目前追本益比偏低，短中期股價有望獲得支撐。追蹤指標應關注後續營收成長續航力及總體經濟變數。
ai_view_en: view: The beat sends a positive signal, and with a low trailing PE, the stock has near-to-mid-term support. Track revenue growth sustainability and macroeconomic variables.
